'''Heracles Almelo''' ({{IPA|nl|ɦeːˈraːkləs ˈɑlməloː|lang}}) is a Dutch professional [[association football|football]] club based in [[Almelo]], founded in 1903. They play in the [[Eerste Divisie]], the second tier of [[Dutch football league system|Dutch football]], following relegation from the [[Eredivisie]] in the [[2025–26 Eredivisie|2025–26 season]]. The club has won the [[List of Dutch football champions|Dutch national title]] twice, in [[1926–27 Netherlands Football League Championship|1927]] and [[1940–41 Netherlands Football League Championship|1941]]. Heracles won the [[2004–05 Eerste Divisie]], gaining promotion to the Eredivisie for the first time in 28 years. The club remained in the top flight for 17 seasons before suffering relegation at the end of the [[2021–22 Eredivisie|2021–22 season]]. Heracles secured an immediate return to the Eredivisie by winning the [[2022–23 Eerste Divisie]], but were relegated again three years later.

In [[2012 KNVB Cup Final|2012]], they reached the [[KNVB Cup]] final for the first time, losing to [[PSV Eindhoven|PSV]] in the final. The club's main rival is [[FC Twente|Twente]]."}}
